ratings.scale: Subjective review judgment: 5 is a usable prototype with obvious shortcomings; 8 is a polished representative vertical slice; 10 would require exceptional end-to-end cohesion plus broader player/platform validation. These are not measured user-study scores.

strengths: Consistent cyan/slate industrial identity and a clean title/briefing layout.
Original rifle and pylon meshes communicate sci-fi technology and the turbine provides a recognizable central silhouette.
Menus and pause/win panels fit1440x900; health and ammo values are readily visible.
The nearby core is recognizable as a floating diamond with a ground pad once within9metres.
The briefing explains recovery, escalation and extraction clearly when deliberately opened.

priorities.issue: Objective and extraction direction depend on a very small radar; distant core beams nearly disappear in the station lighting.
priorities.evidence: Spawn screenshot shows nearestcore52m as tiny8px text, faint world beams and no world labels. All-cores screenshot faces north with extraction64m behind the player; only a tiny radar circle indicates return direction.
priorities.change: Add always-legible world/edge directional markers for named core sites and active extraction, with distance; include a strong vertical extraction beacon. Retain optional low-clutter HUD setting if desired.

priorities.issue: Functional HUD labels are undersized and initial deployment does not teach controls in context.
priorities.evidence: At1440x900, dash instruction, radar range, shield/ammo labels and reload/aim hints are7–9px. There is no first-deployment control strip; controls require a separate menu before deployment.
priorities.change: Use11–13px minimum for functional text; add a short persistent early-operation strip for move/fire/aim/dash/recover and fade it once used.

priorities.issue: Core sites remain visually alike and apparently active after recovery.
priorities.evidence: Targeted all-cores screenshot shows the large cyan pylon and its lit ground pad still fully active after its floating core is removed. The mission's three sites have no distinct names or local story identities.
priorities.change: Give each site a name/number and distinct set dressing; change pylon/beam/pad state on collection so recovery visibly changes the station.

priorities.issue: The human-memory premise has little experiential payoff during the mission.
priorities.evidence: Briefing promises preserved memories; recovery feedback is a resource gain and generic core count, and success is a generic message with three numeric stats.
priorities.change: Add a short authored memory fragment per recovery, with restrained voice/text treatment and a final signal-restored beat. The fragments should motivate the recovery rather than interrupt combat with a modal.

priorities.issue: Extraction is an abrupt boundary trigger followed by a modal; it does not deliver a distinct final beat.
priorities.evidence: Targeted final phase/extraction inspection shows immediate THE SIGNAL LIVES result at insertion radius, without extraction progress, launch/light transition, or in-world completion moment.
priorities.change: Use a clear extraction zone and short hold/progress or last transmission sequence, with unmistakable finish feedback. Keep the sequence bounded and do not add untelegraphed failure.

priorities.issue: The broad repeated courtyard and bright planar reflection patches look procedural; there is no quality setting for WebGL cost.
priorities.evidence: Spawn view is predominantly repeated tiled slabs and symmetrical blocks. The right foreground white reflection is highly blown out and distracts from targets. Settings expose sensitivity/audio/motion but no resolution or shadow quality.
priorities.change: Reduce blown highlights, add purposeful local story/industrial detail and asymmetric landmarks, and expose low/standard/high rendering quality or resolution scale.

method.browser: Installed Chrome via Playwright, headless software WebGL,1440x900
method.normalControls: Clicked menu, briefing, deploy; used W/A to traverse west lane; pressedE while8.5m from core and got distance instruction; paused/resumed. Active enemy fire reduced shield60to41. No teleporting or resource edits during normal traversal.
method.targetedInstrumentation: Debug core collection and extract used after normal traversal solely to inspect final-phase HUD and win presentation. Not a full unassisted mission playthrough.

limits: This is an automated agent review with visual inspection, not independent human feedback.
No numerical rating is a proof of perfection, commercial appeal or AAA readiness.
The browser was closed after the run; no source files were modified.
High-end character animation, narrative production, original sound mix, broader content, accessibility validation and hardware performance work remain outside the current prototype.
